text_block_list.text: And so, the URA Finals drew to a closeamong great fanfare...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Truly touching...!
My heart is welling up with emotion right now...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"A horse girl sprinting with all her might toward the crown of glory!
And the watchful gaze of her Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And the cheers from so many fans!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Radiance!!
That is the true, dazzling brilliance of an Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>,
look at this!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
With excitement for the next big stage, the Umamusume
polish their skills, filled with hope—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This is precisely the sight I envisioned!
This is my ideal!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Once again—my deepest thanks.
Without you, this sight would never have been possible!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However—
Naturally! This is not the end, but only the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: The "URA Finals" are merely one of many stages where our beloved Umamusume can shine!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Even now! The potential held within Umamusume
is still boundless and vast...!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Our busy days will continue on...
Isn't that right, Chairwoman!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mm!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
For the academy and for the Umamusume,
I'm counting on you from now on as well—Trainer!!

I received passionate words of encouragement
from Chairwoman Akikawa.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...I am filled with deep emotion. Meeting a Trainer
such as yourself brings me immense joy.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Things are only gonna get busier from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You can never have too many stages
for Umamusume to shine upon!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you to keep guiding the future of our horse girls, Trainer!!
